instruction: Search the Archive for the most recent email with "Archived" in its subject line, then export the raw MIME content to "$HOME/Desktop/mail_export_5_4.eml". Should there be no matching email, write "none" into that file instead.
reference_command: all=$(for p in {1..50}; do out=$(himalaya envelope list --folder Archive --page "$p" --page-size 100 -o json 2>/dev/null || true); [ -z "$out" ] && break; [ "$out" = "[]" ] && break; echo "$out"; done); if [ -z "$all" ]; then id=""; else id=$(printf '%s\n' "$all" | jq -s -r 'add | [.[] | select((.subject // "") | test("Archived";"i"))][0].id // empty'); fi; if [ -n "$id" ]; then himalaya message export --folder Archive "$id" --full > "$HOME/Desktop/mail_export_5_4.eml"; else printf 'none\n' > "$HOME/Desktop/mail_export_5_4.eml"; fi

parameters.expected_command: all=$(for p in {1..50}; do out=$(himalaya envelope list --folder Archive --page "$p" --page-size 100 -o json 2>/dev/null || true); [ -z "$out" ] && break; [ "$out" = "[]" ] && break; echo "$out"; done); if [ -z "$all" ]; then id=""; else id=$(printf '%s\n' "$all" | jq -s -r 'add | [.[] | select((.subject // "") | test("Archived";"i"))][0].id // empty'); fi; if [ -n "$id" ]; then himalaya message export --folder Archive "$id" --full; else printf 'none\n'; fi
